description: BASELINE: hybrid 0.326, llm-only 0.343, hybrid losing by 1.67pp on 30 cases. RAGAs retrieval poor (recall 25%).

DIAGNOSTIC: B08-001 retrieval+response analysis. Found cross-encoder reranker demoting relevant chunks (Risk Assessment Guide Task A rank #1 hybrid, NOT chosen). Target chunk 3.2.2 ranks #30 (outside top_k=20). Model invents RPN formulas, cites retrieved sources falsely. Hypothesis: bypass cross-encoder.

BYPASS RERANKER: B08-001 composite 0.389→0.611 (+0.222). D1/D2/D4/D5 all near-max; D3 still 0. ctx_recall +0.19. Risk Assessment Guide::Task A now in top-3 as expected. Reranker was the dominant retrieval failure on this case.
TOP_N=8 with bypass: B08-001 composite 0.611→0.389 (REGRESSED). D2/D4/D5 all dropped — too much context overwhelms model. ctx_recall +0.10 but quality of model response far worse. KEEP top_n=3.

METRIC REVISION: switching primary to "mean RAGAs context_recall" per Phase A focus. Composite demoted to tracked-only. Target: ctx_recall 0.250 → 0.70 across 30 cases. New measurement: standalone retrieval evaluator script (.lab/workspace/retrieval_eval.py) — no LLM, no Primus, just retrieval+RAGAs comparison. Re-score baseline + Exp #2 under new metric.
BASELINE re-scored under metric v2 (rerank ON, top_k=20, top_n=3): mean recall_topn=0.142 across 30 cases. recall_topk=0.347. Even at 20 candidates, only 35% of expected clauses are reachable.

Exp #2 re-scored under metric v2 (rerank OFF, top_k=20, top_n=3): mean recall_topn=0.153, +0.011 vs baseline. Marginal at population scale — composite gain on B08-001 was outlier. recall_topk slightly worse (-0.033) — bypass doesn't help candidate set.

TOP_K=50 rerank OFF: recall_topn unchanged (0.153) but recall_topk +0.189 to 0.503. Bigger funnel reaches more candidates but hybrid RRF top-3 doesn't change. Confirms binding constraint is RANKING not WIDTH.
TOP_K=100 rerank OFF: recall_topk hits 0.617 ceiling. Embedder cannot surface ~38% of expected clauses even at k=100. Hard ceiling — needs better embedder or query rewriting.

TOP_K=50 rerank ON (ms-marco): recall_topn 0.133 (-0.020 vs same k rerank OFF). Cross-encoder hurts even with bigger candidate pool. ms-marco doesn't understand regulatory text. Need domain-tuned reranker.

BGE-RERANKER-LARGE k=50 n=3: recall_topn 0.250 (+0.097 vs Exp #5; +0.108 vs baseline). FIRST BREAKTHROUGH on Phase A. Domain-tuned reranker surfaces ground-truth CCoP clauses where ms-marco fails. 8/30 cases at R@N>0. B08-001 canary still failing (R@K=1, R@N=0) — reranker has clauses but doesn't pick them. Latency: ~12× ms-marco.

BGE-RERANKER-LARGE k=100 n=3 (compound test): recall_topn 0.228 (-0.022 vs Exp #7). REGRESSION. Bigger candidate pool HURT discrimination — reranker confused by more plausible-but-wrong passages. recall_topk +0.114 confirms more right answers exist in pool, but they're outranked by distractors. KEEP k=50 with bge-reranker-large.

BGE-RERANKER-V2-M3 k=50 n=3: recall_topn 0.158 (-0.092 vs Exp #7). v2-m3 is multilingual-optimized; loses English regulatory-text precision. Lost 4 perfect cases (B22-015, B12-008, B02-012, B04-001), gained 1 (B02-014). bge-reranker-large is reranker family local max. (First run crashed OOM at 8192-token default; retry with max_length=512.)

QUERY SUFFIX (CCoP boilerplate) bge-reranker-large k=50 n=3: recall_topn 0.153 (-0.097 vs Exp #7). Static suffix dilutes signal — boilerplate vocab dominates embedding. Lost 4 perfect cases. Query rewriting axis is ALIVE (different cases hit) but suffix is wrong implementation. Try HyDE next. 3-DISCARD GUARDRAIL TRIGGERED.

DENSE-ONLY + bge-reranker-large k=50 n=3: recall_topn 0.283 (+0.033 vs Exp #7) — NEW BEST. Hybrid RRF was diluting dense signal with weaker sparse. Dense-only Pareto improvement: 0 losses, 1 gain (B09-019: 0.00->1.00). Cumulative: +0.141 vs baseline (~2× recall). Diagnostic-driven hypothesis matched within 0.001 of prediction.

CORRECTED-GT re-measure: recall_topn 0.257 (-0.026 vs orig GT). recall_topk +0.220 (0.53→0.75) — embedder ceiling much higher than thought. Precision +0.097, F1 +0.054, MRR +0.221 (6× improvement). Original recall_topn was systematically pessimistic due to wrong/incomplete GT references in 24 of 30 cases (agent-team audit).

MULTI-N METRICS: dynamic N=C (cardinality-fair) recall=0.335. Recall climbs 0.26 (N=3) → 0.31 (N=5) → 0.41 (N=8/10). N=3 is structurally pessimistic — mean GT cardinality 4.72 (max 8). Failure modes split: 7 cases reranker-fail (R@K high, R@C low), 6 cases embedder-fail (R@K low). Two distinct fix paths.

CONTEXTUAL CHUNKING (Anthropic) + breadcrumb headers: 495 chunks re-indexed in new collection ccop_clauses_contextual. Embedder ceiling JUMPED 0.75→0.857 (+0.107). Precision +0.081, F1 +0.026. But primary R@C dipped (-0.025) because bge-reranker scoring (query, augmented_text) instead of (query, original) — distracted by breadcrumbs. Bug uncovered; Exp 15 fix: pass original_text to reranker.

DECOUPLE: reranker scoring (query, original_text) instead of (query, augmented_text). Embedder still uses augmented (preserves R@K=0.857). recall@C +0.020 vs #13 (best ever). recall@5 +0.043. recall@8 +0.037. Distance to 0.8 target: 0.445. Reranker now binding constraint at small N.

PARENT-CHILD AUTO-MERGE: window=10, min_siblings=2. Group sibling clauses of same parent in reranker top-10. recall@C +0.064 vs #15 (NEW BEST). 7 cases gained (B04-005 0.75→1.00, B02-012 0.50→1.00, B18-001 0.33→0.67, B14-001 0.20→0.40, B21-001 0.50→0.75, B04-001 0.67→0.83, B08-018 0.17→0.33). 0 lost. Cumulative +196% vs baseline. Distance to 0.8: 0.381. Vocab-mismatch cases still failing — Exp 17 = HyDE.

HyDE (gpt-4o-mini hypothetical clause for retrieval; original query for reranker) + all stack. recall@C +0.012 (modest), but recall@5 +0.042, recall@8 +0.058, recall@10 +0.076, MRR +0.142 (huge). R@K -0.060 (HyDE sometimes drifts vocab). 4 gained (B07-015 0→0.25, B12-008 0.71→0.86, B13-003 0→0.25, B14-001 0.40→0.60). 3 lost. Cumulative +203%. Distance to 0.8: 0.370.

MULTI-QUERY RRF (orig + HyDE merged): regressed -0.017 vs Exp #17. 2 gained / 4 lost. RRF dilutes HyDE's vocab-bridge wins by averaging in the original query's rankings. R@K only partially recovered (0.80 vs target 0.85+). Best stays Exp #17. (lab-only; nothing to reset.)

HyDE + merge_window=15 (was 10) + parent-child merge: NEW BEST recall@C=0.487 (+0.057 vs #17). Pareto win across all recall@N. 4 gained big (B13-003 0.25→1.00, B09-019 0.40→1.00, B18-001 0.67→1.00, B05-016 0.20→0.60). 1 lost (B12-008 0.86→0.43). Cumulative +243% vs baseline. Distance to 0.8: 0.313.
window=20 too aggressive. Recall@3 -0.053 vs #19; 5 lost vs 2 gained. Over-merging displaces strong matches at top-3. Window=15 is local optimum on this axis.

DOC2QUERY (synthetic question chunks baked into index) + HyDE + window=15. R@C -0.006 (marginal regression on primary). R@K +0.041 (recovered from HyDE drift). 2 gained / 2 lost (B05-013 0.25→0.00, B13-003 1.00→0.50 lost — same vocab-mismatch cases HyDE was helping). Hypothesis: Doc2Query + HyDE conflict — chunks already have query-style language, HyDE drift no longer adds value.

DOC2QUERY w/o HyDE: R@C -0.033 vs #19. R@K=0.852 (HIGHEST EVER) but reranker doesn't surface right clauses. MRR collapsed -0.142. 5 gained/6 lost. 3rd consecutive discard — guardrail triggered. KEY INSIGHT: reranker is now binding constraint, R@K saturated. Need different reranker axis or hierarchical chunks.
top_k=100 with full stack: R@C -0.049. R@K=0.886 (highest ever) but reranker drowned. R@K inversely correlated with R@C. 4th consecutive discard — one more = mandatory fork.

RERANKER ON AUGMENTED Doc2Query text. R@C -0.018 (5th discard) but precision@3 +0.074 (BIG), f1@3 +0.048. Polarized: 5 big gains (B05-013/B12-008/B06-002 → 1.00, B23-001 → 0.67), 6 big losses (B01-007/B13-003/B18-001 → 0.00). 5-discard fork entry written. Last stay-on-branch attempt = ensemble rerankers (Exp 25).

RERANKER ENSEMBLE (avg orig + augmented scores). R@C -0.023 (6th discard). Smoothed polarization but couldn't beat Exp 19. Many secondary metrics up (R@5/8/K, prec@3, f1@3) but primary regressed. MANDATORY FORK from baseline.

NO RERANKER fork inversion. R@C 0.480 (-0.007 vs Exp 19, within noise). 8 gained / 10 lost / 11 same. POLARIZED — reranker is double-edged. New cases unlocked (B06-013 0→1.00, B07-022 0→1.00). Insight: dense rank and CE rank are COMPLEMENTARY, not competing.

RRF ENSEMBLE OF DENSE+CE RANKS: NEW BEST R@C=0.4995. recall@5 +0.056 BIG. Captures complementary signals. 8 gained (B07-022 0→0.75, B23-001 0→0.67, B05-013 0.25→0.75) / 6 lost (B04-005 1.00→0.25, B13-003 1.00→0.50). Cumulative +252% vs baseline. Distance to 0.8: 0.30.
RRF DENSE=1.0, CE=1.5: NEW BEST R@C=0.558. CE-favored RRF recovers Exp 19 wins while keeping new gains. 7 cases jumped to 1.00 (B13-003, B13-009, B18-001, B21-001, B01-007).
RRF CE=2.0 over-corrects. CE=1.5 local optimum.
Doc2Query collection + RRF: regressed -0.076. Doc2Query embeddings disrupt rank alignment.
window=50 (full pool): R@C +0.016. B12-016 0.00→0.86 finally cracked. NEW BEST.
WINDOW=40 SWEET SPOT: NEW BEST R@C=0.6534. Pareto Pareto win 5/2/22. Cumulative +361% vs baseline. Distance to 0.8: 0.147.
window=35 worse than 40.
Doc2Query + window=40 still regresses (-0.10).
min_siblings=3 over-filters; window=40 + min=2 is correct.
top_k=100 + RRF: R@K HIGHEST EVER (0.92) but R@C -0.07. Bigger pool overwhelms reranker even with RRF.
BGE-M3 embedder swap: R@K +0.029 but R@C -0.081. Different vector geometry breaks reranker.

GROUNDED contextualization via Claude CLI: hallucination-free contexts (CIIO correctly expanded, accurate section refs) but R@C -0.124 ✗. INSIGHT: Claude's domain-precise contexts mirror clause vocabulary; gpt-4o-mini's looser synonym-heavy contexts add query-vocabulary bridge needed for retrieval. Accuracy ≠ retrieval value.

FIXED gpt-4o-mini contexts (acronym dictionary): hallucinations eliminated (86→0) but R@C -0.118 ✗. The dictionary constraint made outputs shorter/more formulaic, reducing synonym diversity. Hallucinations were retrieval-benign; fixing them traded vocabulary breadth for accuracy. CONFIRMS Exp 39 finding.

ACRONYMS-ONLY contexts (gpt-4o-mini, "use CIIO/CSA/CCoP verbatim, never expand"). Hallucinations eliminated. R@C=0.5484, slightly lower than Exp 33 (-0.105) but PRODUCTION-DEFENSIBLE (no factual errors). 8/30 cases regressed but methodology is now honest. KEEP as new best for production/dissertation despite lower score — Exp 33's higher score relied on accidental hallucination variety, which is not defensible methodology.
